en.text: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

zhSimplified.text: 安息日将尽，七日的头一日，天快亮的时候，抹大拉的马利亚和那个马利亚来看坟墓。

zhTraditional.text: 安息日將盡，七日的頭一日，天快亮的時候，抹大拉的馬利亞和那個馬利亞來看墳墓。

en.text: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.

zhSimplified.text: 忽然，地大震动；因为有主的使者从天上下来，把石头滚开，坐在上面。

zhTraditional.text: 忽然，地大震動；因為有主的使者從天上下來，把石頭滾開，坐在上面。

en.text: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

zhSimplified.text: 他的相貌如同闪电，衣服洁白如雪。

zhTraditional.text: 他的相貌如同閃電，衣服潔白如雪。

en.text: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

zhSimplified.text: 看守的人就因他吓得浑身乱战，甚至和死人一样。

zhTraditional.text: 看守的人就因他嚇得渾身亂戰，甚至和死人一樣。

en.text: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

zhSimplified.text: 天使对妇女说：「不要害怕！我知道你们是寻找那钉十字架的耶稣。

zhTraditional.text: 天使對婦女說：「不要害怕！我知道你們是尋找那釘十字架的耶穌。

en.text: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

zhSimplified.text: 他不在这里，照他所说的，已经复活了。你们来看安放主的地方。

zhTraditional.text: 他不在這裏，照他所說的，已經復活了。你們來看安放主的地方。

en.text: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

zhSimplified.text: 快去告诉他的门徒，说他从死里复活了，并且在你们以先往加利利去，在那里你们要见他。看哪，我已经告诉你们了。」

zhTraditional.text: 快去告訴他的門徒，說他從死裏復活了，並且在你們以先往加利利去，在那裏你們要見他。看哪，我已經告訴你們了。」

en.text: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

zhSimplified.text: 妇女们就急忙离开坟墓，又害怕，又大大地欢喜，跑去要报给他的门徒。

zhTraditional.text: 婦女們就急忙離開墳墓，又害怕，又大大地歡喜，跑去要報給他的門徒。

en.text: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

zhSimplified.text: 忽然，耶稣遇见她们，说：「愿你们平安！」她们就上前抱住他的脚拜他。

zhTraditional.text: 忽然，耶穌遇見她們，說：「願你們平安！」她們就上前抱住他的腳拜他。

en.text: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’tbe afraid. Go tell my brothers thatthey should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”

footnotes.text: 28:10 The word for “brothers” here may be also correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣对她们说：「不要害怕！你们去告诉我的弟兄，叫他们往加利利去，在那里必见我。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌對她們說：「不要害怕！你們去告訴我的弟兄，叫他們往加利利去，在那裏必見我。」

en.text: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

zhSimplified.text: 她们去的时候，看守的兵有几个进城去，将所经历的事都报给祭司长。

zhTraditional.text: 她們去的時候，看守的兵有幾個進城去，將所經歷的事都報給祭司長。

en.text: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

zhSimplified.text: 祭司长和长老聚集商议，就拿许多银钱给兵丁，说：

zhTraditional.text: 祭司長和長老聚集商議，就拿許多銀錢給兵丁，說：

en.text: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.

zhSimplified.text: 「你们要这样说：『夜间我们睡觉的时候，他的门徒来，把他偷去了。』

zhTraditional.text: 「你們要這樣說：『夜間我們睡覺的時候，他的門徒來，把他偷去了。』

en.text: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”

zhSimplified.text: 倘若这话被巡抚听见，有我们劝他，保你们无事。」

zhTraditional.text: 倘若這話被巡撫聽見，有我們勸他，保你們無事。」

en.text: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.

zhSimplified.text: 兵丁受了银钱，就照所嘱咐他们的去行。这话就传说在犹太人中间，直到今日。 （可16·14—18；路24·36—49；约20·19—23；徒1·6—8）

zhTraditional.text: 兵丁受了銀錢，就照所囑咐他們的去行。這話就傳說在猶太人中間，直到今日。 （可16‧14－18；路24‧36－49；約20‧19－23；徒1‧6－8）

en.text: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

zhSimplified.text: 十一个门徒往加利利去，到了耶稣约定的山上。

zhTraditional.text: 十一個門徒往加利利去，到了耶穌約定的山上。

en.text: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.

zhSimplified.text: 他们见了耶稣就拜他，然而还有人疑惑。

zhTraditional.text: 他們見了耶穌就拜他，然而還有人疑惑。

en.text: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “Allauthority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣进前来，对他们说：「天上地下所有的权柄都赐给我了。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌進前來，對他們說：「天上地下所有的權柄都賜給我了。

en.text: Go andmake disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

zhSimplified.text: 所以，你们要去，使万民作我的门徒，奉父、子、圣灵的名给他们施洗。

footnotes.text: - 28:19 或译：给他们施洗，归于父、子、圣灵的名

zhTraditional.text: 所以，你們要去，使萬民作我的門徒，奉父、子、聖靈的名給他們施洗 。

footnotes.text: - 28:19 或譯：給他們施洗，歸於父、子、聖靈的名

en.text: teachingthem to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.

zhSimplified.text: 凡我所吩咐你们的，都教训他们遵守，我就常与你们同在，直到世界的末了。」

zhTraditional.text: 凡我所吩咐你們的，都教訓他們遵守，我就常與你們同在，直到世界的末了。」
